recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: ARC-071/MECH-323 chunk-injection commit-latch: verify/repair multi-step persistence under live selection (use_chunk_proposal_injection=True)
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: V3-EXQ-841 is the first live test of use_chunk_proposal_injection=True combined with a continued multi-episode StepHarness run (train_mode=False, single long-lived agent across formation+probe). In 100% of 32 chunking cells that registered any commitment, realised committed length pinned at exactly 1 step regardless of configured chunk_max_size (2/3/5) -- committed_arc071_chunks == total probe step count (2160 = 30 episodes x 72 steps) with n_segments_uninterrupted=0 throughout. Two live hypotheses need discrimination before a fix: H1 (ree_core wiring) -- the MECH-090 commit latch's step-index advance / re-deliberation suppression does not hold across ticks in this harness configuration; select_action re-evaluates and re-commits from scratch every tick. H2 (experiment readout) -- the internal commitment state persists correctly but this experiment's own _committed_chunk_state()/_segment_commitments() read path (agent.e3._committed_trajectory, agent._committed_step_idx, or the metadata['source']=='arc071_chunk' check) misreads it as resetting every tick. Relevant code: ree_core/hippocampal/module.py:1856 (_build_chunk_candidates, injection), ree_core/policy/policy_chunking.py (note_real_execution/selectable_chunks, crystallisation_min=5), ree_core/agent.py:1373 (set_chunk_source) and the MECH-090 commit-latch/select_action step-advance logic (not yet independently instrumented). SECONDARY, bundle into the same investigation: A_OFF/A_FLAT (non-chunking) control arms registered ZERO pre-devaluation resource contacts in 16/16 cells and z_goal was inactive (ticks_active=0, goal_state_present=false) in all 48 cells of the run -- the inherited arc071_chunking.py baseline (validated by 810a for chunk-ACCUMULATION readiness only) may not carry an active resource-seeking drive adequate for a devaluation-persistence DV that requires reliable resource contact within a bounded probe window.

live_hypotheses: H1: ree_core wiring -- the MECH-090 commit latch's step-index advance / re-deliberation suppression does not hold across ticks in this harness configuration (train_mode=False + use_chunk_proposal_injection=True + StepHarness spanning formation+probe on one long-lived agent); select_action re-evaluates and re-commits from scratch every tick regardless of an existing commitment.

H2: experiment/measurement readout artifact -- the true internal commitment state persists correctly across ticks, but this experiment's own _committed_chunk_state()/_segment_commitments() read path (agent.e3._committed_trajectory or agent._committed_step_idx, or the metadata['source']=='arc071_chunk' check) does not correctly observe it, producing an artefactual 'new commitment every step' reading.

suggested_probes.sketch: Directly instrument agent._committed_step_idx and the commit-latch's re-deliberation-suppression branch tick-by-tick inside select_action, on the two seeds (A_HIER_S2 101, 505) where the effect reproduces cleanly with the smallest chunk size; confirm whether the internal step counter itself ever exceeds 0 before a fresh commit overwrites it.

Independently read the committed trajectory's identity (object id or a monotonic commit-generation counter) at each tick from OUTSIDE _committed_chunk_state()'s existing read path, and compare against what _committed_chunk_state() reports for the same tick; a mismatch isolates the readout as the artifact rather than the substrate.

fanout_recommendation.note: GOV-FANOUT-1: two axes (instrumentation of the real latch vs an independent readout of the same state) rather than one more full 6-arm x8-seed re-run of V3-EXQ-841's design, which would reproduce the same ambiguity at full cost. Whichever hypothesis is confirmed determines whether the fix is ree_core (H1, implement-substrate) or the experiment script's measurement code (H2, queue-experiment redesign of the read path only, no substrate change).

learning_extracted: Novel substrate finding: the ARC-071/MECH-323 chunk-injection-to-commit-latch-persistence pathway (use_chunk_proposal_injection=True under a continued no_grad StepHarness run) has now been live-tested for the first time and shows realised committed length pinned at exactly 1 step in 100% of 32 cells with any commitment, independent of configured chunk_max_size (2/3/5) -- directly falsifying Q-085's own pre-registered gate (b) as currently wired/measured.

Chunk formation/crystallisation itself is dose-dependent in the expected direction (larger chunk_max_size forms more reliably across seeds: 4/8, 7/8, 7/8, 7/8 seeds for S2/S3/S5/FLATCHUNK_S5 respectively) -- the accumulator side of the mechanism behaves sensibly in isolation.

The devaluation-persistence DV as currently harnessed gets zero resource contact in the non-chunking control arms (A_OFF/A_FLAT, 0/16 cells) -- independent of the chunking question, and blocks the FLAT baseline MECH-163 needs regardless of how the chunk-commitment finding resolves.

z_goal is completely inactive (0 active ticks) across the entire 48-cell grid -- consistent with the resource-contact finding and worth checking directly: does the inherited arc071_chunking.py baseline enable any goal-directed resource-seeking drive at all, or is its behaviour driven entirely by incidental exploration/hazard-avoidance?
claim_ids correctly excludes ARC-071 and MECH-323 (exercised as preconditions, not hypotheses under test) -- verified against the script's own stated rationale; no correction needed.
